title: Meet-me-3
tagline: A platform where you meet people randomly
description: We wanted to create something where people can meet random people and make new friends and that too on the chain.
how_its_made:
We had problems integrating the Huddle01 SDK but finally managed to handle it after getting the team's help. We waited till 3rd evening to get the error resolved and ended up finding that there was a problem with the Huddle01 documentation.

Also, creating the random room Ids for the people to handle the randomization was also an issue for us.
